entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Şeyhülislâm Halidefendizâde Mehmet Cemaleddin Efendi (1848–1917) was an Ottoman judge who served as sheikh al-Islam for Sultan Abdul Hamid II between 1891 and 1909.
